title: Classic Algerian Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Algeria, made with tender meat and vibrant spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the algerian and vibrant spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tender meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the potato and 2 cups of water to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
